payload.claim: The strings output shows 'checkSerial' and 'strlen' — the binary checks the serial length and has a dedicated validation function. Try: run_binary(abcdefghijklmnop) to test a 16-char input.

The serial must be exactly 16 characters long AND each character pair (positions 0-1, 2-3, etc.) must have the second char be exactly 1 greater in ASCII value than the first. Try: run_binary(abababababababab)
